_readme: Keyed by theme key; each entry is an ordered list of { claim, direction, ids }. ids are full bloom-data.json record ids. direction is agree|disagree|divided|mixed, hand-assigned against each statement's actual polarity (it is not derivable from vote % alone). Themes with no entry here (access, privacy) render their page without a TOC or insights section. Note: datacenters' 'AI companies shouldn't get special treatment' cites p123, which under the current tag model belongs only to workforce (tags: Economic Benefit, Workforce & Labor). That is intentional: buildThemeView appends any insight-cited record missing from the theme's own statement list, so it still displays and pages correctly.

datacenters.claim: Data center development needs thorough environmental review and reporting
AI companies shouldn't get special treatment
The benefits of data centers are not well established
People disagree about whether data center benefits outweigh the costs

governance.claim: Communities should be involved in decisions about AI
Government use of AI should be transparent and independently audited
